tested_use_case: Startup Law Firms — Startup law firms: formation, financing, and IP counsel — graded on firms' public pages, not league tables. Judged against the ranking's evidence-graded story taxonomy: 56 user stories across 13 themes.
limitations: United States (unavailable): Own offices are India-only and no US office is stated anywhere on the firm's own site; honest negative.
United Kingdom (partial): Own offices are India-only; the firm's own pages describe global reach through the CMS network (which has UK member firms) rather than its own UK practice.
Germany (partial): Own offices are India-only; German coverage is via CMS network member firms per the firm's own global-reach page, not its own practice.
France (partial): Own offices are India-only; French coverage is via CMS network member firms per the firm's own global-reach page, not its own practice.
